source.title: Word list
source.verification: All 8 original image pages visually inspected; original unit order, British spellings, phrases and unit-specific definitions retained. Line-break hyphenation joined; Chinese punctuation normalized.
notes: Unit 9 set 1 and set 2 remain distinct entries; both use en=set for spelling and pronunciation.
orbit, trick and west retain multiple printed parts of speech within their single textbook entries.
Textbook prints report as n. with the gloss 举报（罪案）; retained as printed.
Unit headers are original; any game-world theme is a separate design interpretation.
